2026-09-02.content:
Apigee Edge for Private Cloud release notes are now published on this page.

Release notes and patch announcements for Apigee Edge for Private Cloud are
published here from September 2026 onward. You can [subscribe](#sub) to this
page with a feed reader to be notified when a new release or patch is
published.

Release notes published before September 2026 remain available in the
[Apigee Edge release notes archive](https://docs.apigee.com/release/notes/apigee-release-notes).
